# Icon design record

Generated using the built-in image_gen tool with the imagegen skill. Original output is preserved as icon-master.png; smaller PNG/WebP and desktop icon formats are mechanical exports. True alpha is retained; no checkerboard background is part of the icon.

Final prompt brief: premium playful sculpted 3D application icon of a golden baton loaf with diagonal scoring and a lime streaming swoosh; centered, legible at 48px, generous transparent safe padding, no lettering, no surrounding square tile, no watermark. Warm highlights and a restrained lime accent match the IZ2S charcoal interface.
